keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Diarra row). Infobox "Established: 1054"; "a Soninke state in what is now northwestern Mali, centred on the town of Diarra"; the term Kaniaga refers to land between the upper Senegal River and the Niger bend. The page gives no outline. The kingdom was under the Sosso and Mali empires from the early 13th century and Kaarta "conquered and vassalized" it in 1754 (the kaarta dossier has the vassalage in 1777): those ties are the suzerains' ledgers and do not change the shape.

notes:
Diarra (Diara), additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Page: Kingdom of Diarra (one page, thin: no capital location, no outline, no French or Ségou relation).

The kaarta dossier has Diarra vassalised in 1777 (Kaarta page) and the vassalage ending in April 1855; the Diarra page has Kaarta conquering it in 1754 and Umar Tall executing its last king in 1860. The tukulor-empire dossier records the 1860 gain. The disc and the capital point are the same stand-in as the kaarta dossier and are not a located town; whether Diarra stayed Kaarta's vassal until 1855 is not on the page.
